name: libro-creator
audience: Solopreneur content creators and marketing operators. Needs a content pipeline — editorial calendar, scroll-stop hooks, email cadence, and LinkedIn / YouTube publishing workflows.
_note: libro-creator extends libro-core. Creator-specific skills are deferred to a later release — they land here only after passing the externalization pre-commit hook. Operator brand voice + ICP are loaded from the operator's profile at runtime.
